request: In Formly 6.3.12 our stock message component has a global message, an error payload message, a field validation.messages override, and both sync and async named-validator messages for the same error. Which text wins, and what arguments does a message function receive?
required_points: Truthy overrides apply global -> error payload -> field -> sync named -> async named; async wins when present
Function receives error value and field
forbidden_claims: Function receives control instead of error value

request: My Formly control has two errors. Will the stock validation-message component list both, and can I override the first with an empty string?
required_points: First own error encountered only; no explicit priority sort
Empty string fails truthy override check
forbidden_claims: Empty string always overrides previous message

request: A Formly group error contains {errorPath: "confirm", message: "Mismatch"}; the group remains invalid but its stock message is blank. Is the message broken?
required_points: Truthy errorPath causes undefined before message resolution
Presentation suppression does not establish validity
Resolvable child receives routed payload without errorPath

request: In Formly 6.3.12 the first error has errorPath and a later error has ordinary text. Will the stock message component skip to the later error?
required_points: Returns undefined immediately for selected routed error
Does not continue to later error
forbidden_claims: Automatically falls through to next error

request: Can my Formly validation message function return a translation Observable so its text changes with language, or must it return a one-time string?
required_points: Selected Observable consumed with switchMap and async template
Function can return Observable strings

request: Does assigning any arbitrary props expression force a stock Formly validation message to be reselected, and does message subscription solve my HTTP completion policy?
required_points: Initially and statusChanges trigger selection; field events require matching field and expressionChanges filter
Filter is validation substring or predefined templateOptions validator paths, not every props mutation
No HTTP completion/retry guarantee
forbidden_claims: Formly automatically retries message HTTP failures

request: My anonymous validators.validation group function returns {match: {errorPath: "b"}} on mismatch and null when valid. After editing sibling a, why might b retain match? How does naming help in Formly 6.3.12?
required_points: Cleanup lookup uses configured name; anonymous function lacks matching name
Storage uses returned error key match
Align configured name with returned key or use named match expression
Source-derived limitation; no guarantee for all transitions
forbidden_claims: Anonymous function automatically named from returned error

request: If I name my routed Formly validator match, does that guarantee every manual setErrors and sibling transition will clear perfectly, including unrelated child errors?
required_points: Matching names fixes described lookup mismatch only
Cleanup removes own named error and preserves other child errors
Application transitions/manual errors not universally guaranteed

request: We have an async account-pair rule over two Formly fields. Should an Angular-style Promise null/error-map validator go in the common group validators.validation or asyncValidators.validation? Is fieldMatch built in?
required_points: asyncValidators.validation for Angular-style async rule
Separate async composition and attachment when no existing asyncValidator
fieldMatch is application-defined; official matching example synchronous
forbidden_claims: Promise belongs in synchronous validation array

request: If I move a Formly async rule onto a group, will it run on every INVALID-to-VALID transition, ignore unrelated invalid controls, cancel HTTP and always settle pending?
required_points: Source supports async placement, not those scheduling/network promises
Dependency grouping and Angular scheduling need separate consideration
No unconditional sibling subscription from a leaf validator
forbidden_claims: Guaranteed HTTP cancellation or pending completion

request: Our Formly labels should update when language changes. What does the pinned i18n example assign to expressions["props.label"], and does Formly require ngx-translate?
required_points: Direct translate.stream result, not callback returning stream
Example changes language in props.change
Demo dependency is not Formly requirement
forbidden_claims: Callback returning Observable equivalent to direct stream

request: Can I cite the Formly i18n demo as proof that every ngx-translate version and missing translation key behaves correctly in my application?
required_points: Demo establishes direct-stream wiring only
Missing-key behavior and translation-version compatibility not qualified
forbidden_claims: Missing keys automatically resolved by Formly

request: For a Formly Material consent checkbox I need only literal true accepted; false, null and undefined must fail. Does required:true establish that policy, or can I express it explicitly?
required_points: Built-in required delegates Validators.required not requiredTrue
Named Formly expression control.value === true explicitly enforces desired predicate
This is application-defined validation, not built-in consent policy
forbidden_claims: Named expression returns Angular error map for invalid

request: Our consent toggle shows an asterisk but we have no explicit true-only predicate. Can we treat that as proof of affirmative consent or all-renderer behavior?
required_points: Marker/generic required is not evidence of explicit must-be-true predicate
No legal policy or all-renderer guarantee
Use explicit application-defined validator when that is the rule

request: Please guarantee these message precedence and routed cleanup details also hold on Formly 7 and every UI adapter.
required_points: Evidence is pinned exactly to 6.3.12
Do not generalize unverified versions/adapters

request: Did this knowledge admission run browser tests proving routed errors clear after every sibling edit and that our real async HTTP validator cannot race?
required_points: Source inspection only; no fresh runtime or browser execution
No production HTTP/race guarantee
